You have one new message from Xenocorp: Good morning, Employee 119, and welcome to the Xenocorp family. We are pleased to confirm your appointment to the position of XenoGuesser. You will shortly be deployed to planet Veyra Prime. Owing to magnetic interference, your landing site cannot be predicted. Your task is to identify it in order to aid in the calibration of our orbital satellite systems. Following a review of operational costs, we are aiming to reduce the size of our team by 50%. For this reason, only employees that successfully meet their assigned productivity targets will be retained. Please note that return transport to Earth is no longer provided. Departing employees will instead be released via the airlock. We are advised that the procedure is painless. Xenocorp: Finding Our Place in the Universe.
